This tab controls the tiles on the Vital Reports Home page.

  • New Tile — add a tile: give it a label, an SLDS icon (e.g. standard:report), a target tab, a color, and a display order.
  • Audience — Both shows the tile to everyone, User to non-admins only, Admin to users with the Vital Reports Admin View permission.
  • Show / Hide — the toggle activates or hides a tile without deleting it; Delete removes it for good.
  • A tile is automatically hidden from anyone who can't see its target tab, so it never shows as a broken link.

Changes apply on the next Home page load (a hard refresh clears the cache).
